result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_successors()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get direct successors of a node (outgoing neighbors). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5137-L5186){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_successors(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns nodes that are targets of outgoing edges from the specified node. Only available for directed graphs. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID or label to find successors for. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of successor node IDs (nodes that `node=` points to). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#609181b0 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node("A") graph.add_node("B") graph.add_node("C") graph.add_edge("A", "B") graph.add_edge("A", "C") a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") # Find nodes that A points to; returns node IDs successors = graph.get_successors(a_id) # Convert to labels: ['B', 'C'] labels = [graph.get_label_from_id(nid) for nid in successors] # Returns ['B', 'C'] labels ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['B', 'C'] ``` ::: :::
